gsiAsReportedByGrok.classification: ___native_owner_charge sets CHARGE_CLOSED only in the run_cleanup_gate bit0 branch and CHARGE_OVERFLOW only in the overflow branch. ___run_child_begin sets ALLOC at the malloc-null return and JOURNAL on the publish-failure rollback before the activation is linked. ___run_entry_begin maps that site onto the existing reason field and does not label every 0 as CLOSED.
gsiAsReportedByGrok.servicePath: Worker wrapper reads only its stack outcome. It enters for(;;) service_sync_op only when admitted==0, site==CHARGE_CLOSED, close_proof==1, and close_origin==DESTROY. The proof scalars are copied in that closed-bit branch before native_lookup_unpin. The wrapper does not reread the VM or owner.
gsiAsReportedByGrok.parentPin: ___native_owner_reserve_worker charges the worker and stores startup_root before start_processor_execution reaches ___run. The close-refusal loop does not uncharge, zero run_entry_count, drop the journal, clear startup_root, or set handler_quiet. ___native_owner_reclaim_joined calls ___thread_join before uncharge and journal drop. cohort_tail_pin is the per-barrier mailbox pin, not this lifetime pin. No fake marker was added.
gsiAsReportedByGrok.setjmp: The outcome object lives in the caller frame. ___run_with_outcome writes it before ___BEGIN_TRY and does not write it inside the try. A nested call receives a different stack outcome. longjmp to this frame's catcher does not replace the outer object.
gsiAsReportedByGrok.crossVm: include/gambit.h defines ___SINGLE_VM. This image has no legal second virtual machine, so same processor id across VMs was not entered. No forged ps and no toy interpreter were used. The global id-indexed array is gone. Same-id nested and repeated calls went through ___run_with_outcome.
